{{Quote|If you're in the mood for fish, this seafood slider features a grilled firaxan shark fillet in place of the standard patty, topped with Ahto City cheese, chewy Selkathian seaweed and relish squiggles.|The menu at Dex's description of the Manaan slider|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Ahto City cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] used in cooking. In the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which was run by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], served Ahto [[City/Legends|City]] cheese as a topping on the [[Manaan slider]], which Jettster enjoyed the taste of. The [[slider]] cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was inspired by the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]],<ref name="DaD" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of which was named [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The cheese was served on a grilled [[Firaxan shark/Legends|firaxan shark]] fillet along with [[Selkathian seaweed]] and [[relish]] between two trans-shipped, medium-density [[foodboard]]s. The slider was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ahto City cheese was featured in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" />
